accepted_rule_changes: Hold explicit supporting-document absence for a 120-minute logical confirmation window.
Resolve pending concerns when a current structured snapshot supplies the document.
Abstain on explicit conflicting source state.
Move an otherwise valid signal to observe-only when explicit as-of manual-review-start is supplied.
Avoid a duplicate recommendation when an explicit overlapping source warning is supplied.
expected_trade_off: Lower volume and redundant review at the cost of 120 minutes additional logical latency and possible recall reduction.
rejected_rule_changes: Use source system, referral source or service line as a risk proxy.
Activate source-warning suppression on benchmark data where no warning is supplied.
Infer manual review start from future completeness events.
Use development or holdout labels in prioritisation.

rules.expected_recall_trade_off: May miss concerns resolved within 120 minutes.
rules.reason: Development diagnostic found corrected snapshots caused false-positive and redundant review burden.
rules.safety_implications: Adds latency only; retains recommendation-only authority.
